article.title: Spaceback把社群素材轉成互動展示廣告
article.title_en: Spaceback turns social assets into interactive display ads
article.summary: Spaceback正式推出Interactive Display Units，讓品牌由既有社群內容製作測驗、投票及遊戲等展示廣告。
article.summary_en: Spaceback made Interactive Display Units generally available for adapting social content into quizzes, polls and games.
highlights: 平台按品牌貼文、色彩及標誌建立選項，再由廣告主挑選。
素材以標準展示尺寸交付，可經DSP或Spaceback Deal ID投放。
highlights_en: The platform builds options from brand posts, colors and logos for advertiser selection.
Standard-size assets run through DSPs or a Spaceback Deal ID.
article.why: 社群內容可延伸至可互動的展示版位，創意營運團隊可決定哪些貼文適合改成測驗、揭示或遊戲流程。
article.why_en: Creative operations can choose which social posts fit a quiz, reveal or playable display sequence.
article.next_step: 選一則有明確產品訊息的貼文，分別設計投票與揭示流程，核對互動完成後的訊息及落地頁是否一致。
article.next_step_en: Turn one clear product post into poll and reveal concepts, checking the end message and destination.
article.detail: DSP是讓買方採購程式化廣告的平台，Deal ID則用於辨識交易安排。新格式涵蓋測驗、投票、刮開揭示及遊戲等類型，品牌可按原素材選擇互動機制。團隊可先檢查訊息在不同尺寸及操作步驟中的呈現，再比較要保留哪些社群元素，安排小範圍的素材測試及媒體交付。
article.detail_en: A DSP supports programmatic buying, while a Deal ID identifies a trading arrangement. Formats include quizzes, polls, scratch-to-reveal units and games. Inspect message presentation across sizes and interaction steps before choosing which social elements to retain for limited testing and delivery.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
